situation: Talking about difficulty with honorific language

lines.speaker: Learner
lines.meaning: honorific language is still difficult for me.

lines.speaker: Partner
lines.romanization: gwaenchanayo. jaju yeonseuphamyeon jeomjeom swiw o jyeoyo.
